The '''Green Gardens''', also known as the '''Green Jedi Territory''', was a large garden in the [[Governmental Sector|Government District]] of [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City]] on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. It was named after [[Green Jedi Enclave]], which was located on the south side of the gardens.
